elements.element: The transition-assistance obligation is triggered by expiry or termination without an additional request condition.
elements.evidence: Although the clause applies upon expiry or termination, IBM's duty to provide assistance is expressly conditioned on Customer's request.
IBM is required to provide reasonable transition assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies IBM's then-current rates.

elements.element: The data-return obligation is triggered by expiry or termination without an additional request condition.
elements.evidence: Data return is conditioned on Customer's request rather than arising automatically upon expiry or termination.
IBM must return all Content and other Customer data.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: A commonly used, machine-readable format substantively satisfies this requirement.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Customer's request, which could occur more than 30 days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: The clause requires IBM thereafter to delete the returned Content and Customer data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion after the data return.
elements.evidence: IBM must certify the deletion to Customer in writing after return.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance upon expiry or termination without an additional request condition.
elements.evidence: The assistance obligation is subject to Customer making a request.

elements.element: The transition-assistance period is at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The stated period of up to six months encompasses the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data.
elements.evidence: IBM must return all Content and other Customer data.

elements.element: The data-export obligation is triggered by expiry or termination without an additional request condition.
elements.evidence: IBM's data-return obligation arises only upon Customer's request.

elements.element: Customer Data is exported or returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the 30-day deadline from Customer's request rather than from expiry or termination.

result.reason: Neither level is fully satisfied because the redline adds Customer-request conditions and measures the data-return deadline from that request rather than from expiry or termination. It also applies upon termination of any individual Service Option Attachment while requiring return and deletion of all Content and Customer data. That overbroad scope could disrupt services continuing under other attachments, contrary to the original clause's preservation of obligations under unaffected attachments.
